name: Front Yard, New Jersey
lede: A Deckorators press release presents a front-of-home redesign at a New Jersey farmhouse-style home: an all-season lounge with Bromic Platinum Electric heaters built in, beside a custom swing bed.
beats: The front yard of a farmhouse-style home, redesigned around a deck, a porch and a lounge.
The lounge was to be used in every season, as part of the national “Year of the Front Yard” campaign.
Premier Outdoor Living built Bromic Platinum Electric heaters into the all-season lounge, beside a custom Deckorators swing bed.
team: Builder and installer: Premier Outdoor Living (Deckorators Certified Elite Pro)
